service.en: Withdraw a domestic worker absconding report (worker)
service.ar: سحب بلاغ تغيب عامل خدمة منزلية (العامل)
service.ur: گھریلو ملازم کی غیر حاضری رپورٹ واپس لینا (ملازم)

about: Let a domestic worker ask to cancel an absconding report filed against them.
note: Requirements read from the official MOHRE service page on the checked date. Field labels sit behind sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: An absconding report must already exist
The worker's residence visa is needed, valid or not
fees: 115 AED outside Dubai; Dubai is handled by its residency directorate
Business centres may add a commission of up to 72 AED
